name: Brick Classification and Empty Space Skipping
aliases: Brick classification and empty space skipping
definition: A technique to classify bricks into three categories (skipped/empty, early termination/saturated, or sampled densely) to bypass large sets of work, maintaining state in a shared array on GPU and host memory.
summary: Brick Classification and Empty Space Skipping accelerates volume rendering by categorizing bricks as skipped, terminated, or sampled, distinguished by its shared classification table enabling ray-guided feedback updates.
